EC1: The patients have other cancers  at the same time [OR] or have the history of other cancers [NOT] except controlled skin basal cell carcinoma [OR] or skin squamous cell carcinoma [OR] or carcinoma in situ of cervix uterus;
EC2: The patients have active infections that were [NOT] not suitable for chemotherapy;
EC3: The patients have severe non-cancerous diseases.
EC4: The patients have history of neoadjuvant hormone therapy.
EC5: The patients have bilateral breast cancers [OR] or DCIS [OR] or metastatic breast cancers.
EC6: The patients are undergoing current administration of anti-cancer therapies [OR], or are attending other clinical trials.
EC7: The patients are pregnant [OR] or lactational [OR], or they [NOT] refuse to practice contraception during the whole trial.
EC8: The patients are in some special conditions that they can't understand the written informed consent, such as they are demented or hawkish.
EC9: The patients have allergic history [OR] or contraindication [AND] of tamoxifen.
